name: denorm_preserve
description: Gradual underflow for requested floating-point preservation modes.
cost_note: FP16 uses native half arithmetic; FP32 replaces most arithmetic and comparisons with software; FP64 uses software binary64. About 7x GPU time was reported for a workload requesting FP32 preservation. Per-operation cost is unmeasured.
performance_reason: vkd3d-proton requires both FP32 denorm controls for SM 6.2 and higher; only shaders requesting the modes pay the cost, and DXC default fp32 denorm mode any requests neither.
off_consequence: Without either FP32 denorm control, vkd3d-proton limits non-NVIDIA D3D12 devices to SM 6.1; SM 6.2 and higher are unavailable.

name: denorm_flush
description: Flush subnormal results to zero in requested floating-point modes.
cost_note: FP32 adds exponent-mask fixups to selected operations; no full software FP32 replacement. Per-operation cost is unmeasured. FTZ16 and FTZ64 are unsupported.
performance_reason: vkd3d-proton requires both FP32 denorm controls for SM 6.2 and higher; only shaders requesting the modes pay the cost, and DXC default fp32 denorm mode any requests neither.
off_consequence: Without either FP32 denorm control, vkd3d-proton limits non-NVIDIA D3D12 devices to SM 6.1; SM 6.2 and higher are unavailable.

name: ray_tracing
description: Acceleration structures, ray queries and continuation-based ray-tracing pipelines.
cost_note: AS construction and traversal use compute and continuation dispatch. Work is selected by RT commands and shaders. Runtime cost is unmeasured.

property_bits.subgroupSupportedStages: VK_SHADER_STAGE_RAYGEN_BIT_KHR | VK_SHADER_STAGE_ANY_HIT_BIT_KHR | VK_SHADER_STAGE_CLOSEST_HIT_BIT_KHR | VK_SHADER_STAGE_MISS_BIT_KHR | VK_SHADER_STAGE_INTERSECTION_BIT_KHR | VK_SHADER_STAGE_CALLABLE_BIT_KHR

off_consequence: Vulkan acceleration-structure, ray-query and ray-tracing pipeline interfaces and D3D12 DXR are unavailable; the RTXPT DXR path cannot run.

name: pixel_interlock
description: Pixel interlock with cross-sample ordering for multisampled rendering.
cost_note: Sample interlock and single-sample pixel interlock use native raster order groups. Multisample pixel interlock captures coverage and inputs, then performs ordered load/replay/store passes in bounded tile and primitive batches with CPU/GPU continuation sequencing and scratch clearing. Cost scales with actual coverage, sample count and batch count; per-use runtime cost is unmeasured.
performance_reason: vkd3d-proton requires pixel and sample interlock for ROV support and D3D FL12_1; the multisample envelope is selected only for shaders using pixel interlock with multisampling.
off_consequence: Pixel interlock is unavailable, including its native single-sample route; vkd3d-proton loses ROV support and D3D FL12_1. Native sample interlock and ordered color attachment access remain available.

name: pipeline_statistics
description: Stage-dependent pipeline statistics for explicitly active queries.
cost_note: Inactive fragment and pre-geometry counter regions specialize away. An active fragment invocation loads its counter address and performs one low-word device atomic, with a high-word atomic on overflow. Active IA and geometry queries use their selected report paths. GPU timing is unmeasured.
performance_reason: The macfx-vkd3d translator requires pipelineStatisticsQuery for D3D feature level 11_0; inactive queries retain the default-false shader specialization.
off_consequence: Core Vulkan pipeline-statistics queries are unavailable. The macfx-vkd3d feature-level 11_0 capability check fails. This entry does not disable shader demote, helper invocation semantics, mesh queries or primitives-generated queries.

name: mesh_shader
description: Native object and mesh shaders with virtual task grids and sliced output when required.
cost_note: Unsliced direct mesh uses one native mesh render call. Virtual task batches add prepare, task and prefix compute followed by mesh rendering; output slicing and retained replay add selected captures and mesh draws. Queries add counters only when used. Per-use GPU instruction count and runtime cost are unmeasured.
performance_reason: vkd3d-proton requires both meshShader and taskShader for D3D12 MeshTier1; disabling them removes feature-level 12.2 eligibility.
off_consequence: D3D12 MeshTier1 and feature-level 12.2 are unavailable; mesh/task Vulkan shaders and mesh queries are unavailable. Lower feature levels remain subject to their other requirements; this entry does not remove a shader-model requirement or a translator device-creation prerequisite.

name: polygon_points
description: Polygon POINT rasterization through captured primitive expansion.
cost_note: POINT emits two triangles per point after capture; FILL and eligible thin LINE draws retain native alternatives. Availability alone adds no shader code.
performance_reason: Preserve the non-solid fill feature selected by D3D translators; POINT cost is selected by actual polygon state.
off_consequence: Hides fillModeNonSolid and dynamic polygon mode, including native wireframe because Vulkan shares its feature bit with POINT; translator non-solid fill support is lost; SM and FL effects are not independently established.

name: line_expansion
description: Wide, rectangular, smooth and stippled Bresenham line rasterization.
cost_note: Selected wide/smooth/stipple lines capture vertices and emit expanded primitives; smooth lines add fragment alpha coverage and stipple adds dash generation. Thin default solid lines remain native.
performance_reason: Retain translator-selected line features until disabling them is established to preserve device creation and D3D feature levels; only actual expanded lines pay the cost.
off_consequence: Hides wide, rectangular, smooth and stippled Bresenham line features and their dynamic selectors; native thin Bresenham lines remain; SM/FL and translator device-creation neutrality are not established.

name: dynamic_coverage
description: Dynamic fragment sample mask and alpha-to-coverage lowering.
cost_note: Dynamic sample mask loads root state and filters coverage; nonconstant alpha-to-coverage computes a dither mask and demotes samples. Constant opaque alpha omits alpha coverage lowering. Rasterization sample count uses native attachment variants.
performance_reason: Preserve translator-selected dynamic coverage state; no evidence establishes device-creation neutrality when these controls are hidden.
off_consequence: Hides dynamic sample-mask and alpha-to-coverage selectors; static coverage and native dynamic rasterization sample count remain; SM/FL and translator device-creation neutrality are not established.

name: dynamic_vertex_input
description: Runtime vertex attribute descriptions and format conversion for dynamic vertex input.
cost_note: Dynamic vertex inputs load format, divisor and stride metadata for consumed attributes and perform format-dependent conversion; static pipelines retain constant attribute specialization. Unused inputs emit no fetch work.
performance_reason: DXVK and vkd3d-proton shader-model, feature-level and required device-creation checks do not require dynamic vertex-input state; static pipeline input remains available.
off_consequence: No D3D shader-model, feature-level or translator device-creation loss in the checked DXVK/vkd3d-proton paths; dynamic vertex-input pipelines must use static vertex layouts instead.

name: multiview_geometry_tessellation
description: Original-view replay for geometry and tessellation multiview producers.
cost_note: Advanced multiview producers execute for each active view using the original view index; single-view and ordinary native vertex amplification remain separate paths. Emitted producer instructions are repeated by view count, with a per-draw view load when used.
performance_reason: These advanced multiview combinations are not required by the checked D3D maximum shader-model, feature-level or translator device-creation predicates; ordinary multiview remains available.
off_consequence: No D3D maximum shader-model, feature-level or translator device-creation loss in checked paths; vkd3d-proton ViewInstancingTier can fall from tier 2 to unsupported when its advanced-multiview predicate requires these features.

name: quad_control
description: Full-quad helper invocation and quad derivative control around native quad operations.
cost_class: native quad operations / helper merge guard
cost_note: Native quad and subgroup instructions are retained. A shader requiring full or coarse quad helper invocations can add the existing barycentric triangle-merge guard, or a sample-mask output when no color store exists; unused helper requirements emit neither guard.
performance_reason: vkd3d-proton requires shaderQuadControl together with maximal reconvergence to advance from SM 6.6 to SM 6.7 and later; only affected fragment requirements select the helper guard.
off_consequence: vkd3d-proton cannot expose SM 6.7 or later through its ordinary quad-control/reconvergence path when the earlier SM 6.6 requirements are satisfied; no additional feature-level or device-creation loss is established.

name: texel_buffer_alignment
description: Single-texel-offset buffer views over aligned native textures and raw buffer addresses.
cost_note: Typed native buffer access adds logical range comparison, prefix addition and invalid-coordinate selection; dynamic RGB32 views also select stride and fetch consumed components. Raw/R64 and sparse accesses retain required range and residency work. Unused shaders emit no texel-view code. Runtime cost is unmeasured.
performance_reason: vkd3d-proton requires both single-texel alignment promises for D3D12 device creation at the supported 16-byte native alignment; only shaders accessing texel-buffer views pay the adjustment cost.
off_consequence: vkd3d-proton v3.1 rejects D3D12 device creation when either single-texel alignment promise is absent at 16-byte alignment, making all D3D12 feature levels unavailable.

name: cull_distance
description: Whole-primitive rejection from cull distances written by the final pre-raster shader.
cost_note: Mesh shaders use native primitive rejection. Ordinary producers writing cull distances use capture and an all-vertex negative test per plane before clipping; each tested vertex loads one scalar distance, and testing stops at the first nonnegative or NaN value. No cull output selects no cull capture. GPU time is unmeasured.
performance_reason: DXVK requires shaderCullDistance for translator device creation; capture is selected only by actual final-producer cull output.
off_consequence: DXVK cannot create its D3D device without shaderCullDistance; Vulkan cull-distance shader support is unavailable.
